Dear 

I hope you are doing well.

I am currently staying at your property under a one-month reservation made through your platform. I would like to raise a concern regarding a new rule that has been implemented by the building management two days ago.

The management has recently required that all guests must be physically present downstairs to collect their orders from the restaurant or supermarket. However, this condition was not mentioned at the time of booking and has only been introduced after my stay had already begun.

Unfortunately, this requirement is not practical for me, as it would require me to go downstairs multiple times a day, which is highly inconvenient.

I kindly request your assistance in resolving this issue. Since this policy was not part of the original booking terms, I believe it should not be applied to my current stay. I would appreciate it if you could coordinate with the building management to find a reasonable solution, or provide an alternative arrangement.

Thank you for your understanding and prompt support.
Reihaneh til 
3105 t2 Vida Dubai mall 
Confirmation code
GY-jjJjgCE6
